Monitoring Activity: Review service availability, security incidents, major control changes and unresolved critical findings
Frequency / Trigger: Continuous alerts where feasible; formal quarterly review or stricter policy cadence
Escalation Trigger: Material incident, missed SLA, unresolved critical finding
Record to Retain: Monitoring log, incident reference and decision record

Monitoring Activity: Review assurance status, security findings, access model, subcontractors and remediation progress
Frequency / Trigger: Quarterly monitoring; at least annual formal reassessment as illustrative baseline
Escalation Trigger: Assurance expiry, material exception or overdue high-risk action
Record to Retain: Review checklist, evidence references and action log

Monitoring Activity: Review service performance, assurance changes and risk register
Frequency / Trigger: Semiannual monitoring; annual or risk-based reassessment
Escalation Trigger: Scope change, new sensitive data or service degradation
Record to Retain: Review record and updated risk assessment

Monitoring Activity: Confirm service remains low impact and contact/contract information is current
Review material security incident, ownership change, merger/acquisition, new location, subprocessor or integration change
Frequency / Trigger: Event-driven, as soon as practicable under policy/contract
Escalation Trigger: Any material change affecting risk, obligations or continuity
Record to Retain: Reassessment, approvals and revised treatment plan

Monitoring Activity: Track contractual renewal, insurance/assurance expiry where relevant, open findings and exception expiry
Frequency / Trigger: At least 90 days before renewal/expiry as illustrative process target
Escalation Trigger: Evidence expires or renewal begins with unresolved critical risk

Monitoring Activity: Execute exit controls at termination or transition
Escalation Trigger: Unrevoked access, unreturned data or incomplete deletion confirmation
Record to Retain: Access revocation record, data return/deletion confirmation and exit sign-off
